name: Shield Slam
description: Slam the target with your shield, causing 264 to 276 damage, modified by [S03 - Tuning and Overrides Passive - Warrior: twice]your shield block value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target.  Also causes a high amount of threat. [S03 - Tuning and Overrides Passive - Warrior: Hitting a target with Shield Slam also grants you 4 Attack Power for each point of your defense skill beyond (60 * 5). Lasts 15 sec]
